title: RepoHealthCheck
description: One declared health command. Source file: governance/repo-health.json ({"entries": [RepoHealthCheck]}). T-0157/I-0035: this schema used to describe the CONTAINER while every other schema describes one record, which is why the journal could not be listed in schema-check's PAIRS and the contract was read by nothing. The shared runner (`run_health_checks` in `src/nouns/health.ts`, called from `task verify`) executes these under their declared timeout_seconds.
